title: Nurowerx Research Systems: A Modular Architecture for Evidence Provenance, Computational Evaluation, Scientific Visualization, and Human Review
description: Nurowerx Research Stack (NRS) is a local research application connecting typed provenance records, executed evaluations, scientific charts and attributed review. Four modules—TRACE, LOOP, LENS and FRAME—share version-specific identifiers and schemas. The resulting workflow preserves a dataset, execution configuration, output, assessment, correction and subsequent report without overwriting earlier evidence. This report describes the implemented architecture and its limits. Release validation comprises 35 backend, 12 visualization and 7 browser tests, together with 18 controlled evaluation executions across three synthetic seeds. The contribution is an inspectable integration and reproduction package. It does not establish real-world predictive validity, authenticated authorship or human-user benefit. Technical report, not peer reviewed.
